race: 361G Irish EBF (M)(Ladies P-Am) INH Flat Race
text: The Irish Horseracing Regulatory Board Veterinary Officer examined Found It, trained by Gordon Elliott, at the request of the Raceday Stewards and reported the animal to be post race normal.
S. O'Callaghan, rider of Likable Chancer, trained by Daniel John Howard, reported to the Clerk of the Scales that his mount hung in on the bottom bend each time.
Anna McGuinness, rider of Harry's Dream, trained by P.J. Rothwell, reported to the Clerk of the Scales that her mount ran in snatches.
Alan O'Sullivan, rider of Kimy (FR), trained by Thomas Mullins, reported to the Clerk of the Scales that his mount hung left throughout.
